title: LA Colossal – Ru-Guan 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Lebanese woman in her late 30s, voluminous black waves, natural face with kohl-lined eyes and a warm smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Ru ware celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. High-gloss deep saturated blue-green glaze clearly different from skin, with a bold network of dark crackle lines and fine secondary crackle, no painted motifs, not kintsugi. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully glazed and crackled.

Pose: Seated upright on a round stone stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch blue-green crackle-glazed platform stiletto sandals with ribbon laces tied in a bow below the knee.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, blue-green.

Background & Lighting: Contemporary ceramics museum hall with celadon vessels on plinths, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft museum light with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
